drills.title: Join the consonant to the vowel

items.text: Could you pick it up on your way out?
items.tip: 把 pick、it、up 连成 pick-it-up，词尾辅音直接接到后面的元音上。
items.zh: 你出去的时候能顺便把它拿上吗？

items.text: I'll be back in an hour or two.
items.tip: back-in-an-hour 整串连读，hour 前面的 an 几乎一带而过。
items.zh: 我一两个小时后回来。

items.text: She's not at all interested in the offer.
items.tip: not-at-all 连成一个节奏组，at 的 t 轻触即过。
items.zh: 她对那个提议一点都不感兴趣。

items.text: We need to check it out before we sign anything.
items.tip: check-it-out 中间不要停顿，it 的 t 变成轻快的闪音。
items.zh: 签字之前我们得先把它核实一下。

items.text: Turn it off and on again, then give it a minute.
items.tip: turn-it-off-and-on 一口气连读，off 和 and 之间不要断开。
items.zh: 把它关掉再打开，然后等一分钟。

items.text: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
items.tip: an-apple 和 apple-a 都要连起来，读成 a-napple-a-day。
items.zh: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

items.text: I'm going to ask her about it after the meeting.
items.tip: ask-her-about-it 连读，her 的 h 可以弱化甚至省略。
items.zh: 会议结束后我会问她这件事。

items.text: There's a lot of ice on the road this morning.
items.tip: lot-of-ice-on 中 t、f、s 依次滑向后面的元音，保持气流不断。
items.zh: 今天早上路上有很多冰。

items.text: He walked into the office and asked for a seat.
items.tip: walked-into 和 office-and 连读，and 弱读成 /ən/。
items.zh: 他走进办公室，要了一个座位。

items.text: Put it in the box over there by the door.
items.tip: put-it-in 三词连成一拍，box-over 之间也顺势连接。
items.zh: 把它放在门边那个箱子里。

items.text: I think we should leave now, before it gets dark.
items.tip: 重读 think、leave、now、dark；I 和 should 要轻。
items.zh: 我觉得我们应该现在就走，趁天还没黑。

items.text: She's really good at explaining difficult ideas.
items.tip: 重读 really、good、explaining、difficult，其余虚词快速带过。
items.zh: 她很擅长解释复杂的概念。

items.text: The meeting isn't on Tuesday; it's on Thursday.
items.tip: 对比重音落在 Tuesday 和 Thursday 上，两个词要明显抬高。
items.zh: 会议不在周二，而是在周四。

items.text: I'd love to come, but I'm working late that evening.
items.tip: 重读 love 和 but，用 but 的加重表达转折和歉意。
items.zh: 我很想来，但那天晚上我要加班。

items.text: That's not what I ordered — I asked for the soup.
items.tip: 重读 not 和 soup，用重音突出纠错的重点。
items.zh: 这不是我点的——我要的是汤。

items.text: I need to confirm the reservation before we leave.
items.tip: confirm 重音在第二音节，reservation 重音在第三音节 -va-。
items.zh: 出发前我需要确认一下预订。

items.text: The photographer took a beautiful photograph.
items.tip: photographer 重音在 -tog-，photograph 重音在最前，注意区分。
items.zh: 那位摄影师拍了一张漂亮的照片。

items.text: It's important to practise pronunciation every day.
items.tip: important 重音在 -por-，practise 重音在前，pronunciation 重音在 -na-。
items.zh: 每天练习发音很重要。

items.text: She made a generous offer, but I politely refused.
items.tip: generous 重音在首音节，politely 和 refused 重音都在后段。
items.zh: 她提出了一个慷慨的提议，但我礼貌地拒绝了。

items.text: We discussed the proposal and agreed to revise it.
items.tip: discussed 重音在后，proposal 重音在 -po-，agreed 和 revise 也要加重。
items.zh: 我们讨论了这个提案，并同意修改。

items.text: The ship left at six, and the sheep stayed on the hill.
items.tip: ship 的 /ɪ/ 短而松，sheep 的 /iː/ 长而紧，嘴角要拉开。
items.zh: 船六点离开了，羊留在了山坡上。

items.text: I live here, but I leave for work at seven.
items.tip: live 用短音 /ɪ/，leave 用长音 /iː/，别把两个词读成同一个。
items.zh: 我住在这里，但我七点出发去上班。

items.text: You'd be a fool to pay full price for that.
items.tip: fool 和 full 对比：前者 /uː/ 拖长，后者 /ʊ/ 短促。
items.zh: 你要是全价买那个就太傻了。

items.text: The bed in that hotel was bad, but the view was great.
items.tip: bed 的 /e/ 和 bad 的 /æ/ 要分清，bad 张嘴更大。
items.zh: 那家酒店的床很差，但风景很好。

items.text: I think this thin jacket is the wrong thing for winter.
items.tip: thin 和 thing 结尾不同：前者舌尖轻触齿间，后者是鼻音 /ŋ/。
items.zh: 我觉得这件薄夹克不适合冬天。

drills.title: Sounds that trip up Chinese speakers

items.text: I left my hat in the hot car outside the shop.
items.tip: hat 的 /æ/ 嘴形扁而大，hot 的 /ɒ/ 嘴唇收圆，两个词不要混。
items.zh: 我把帽子落在商店外面那辆热乎乎的车里了。

items.text: The right light above the door isn't working.
items.tip: right 以 /t/ 收尾，light 以 /t/ 收尾但元音不同：/aɪ/ 要饱满。
items.zh: 门上方右边那盏灯坏了。

items.text: It was pure luck that the lock finally opened.
items.tip: luck 的 /ʌ/ 短促居中，lock 的 /ɒ/ 圆唇，对比着读。
items.zh: 锁最后能打开纯属运气。

items.text: Three trees were planted along the thin path.
items.tip: three 的 /θ/ 舌尖伸出齿间，tree 的 /tr/ 舌尖卷起，别读成同一个音。
items.zh: 沿着那条窄小路种了三棵树。

items.text: I think the sink in the kitchen is leaking again.
items.tip: think 是 /θɪŋk/，sink 是 /sɪŋk/，前者舌尖必须碰到上齿。
items.zh: 我觉得厨房的水槽又漏水了。

items.text: Are you coming to the party on Saturday?
items.tip: 一般疑问句用升调，句尾 Saturday 明显上扬。
items.zh: 你周六来参加派对吗？

items.text: Where did you put the keys this time?
items.tip: 特殊疑问句用降调，keys 之后音高下落，不要学成升调。
items.zh: 你这次把钥匙放哪儿了？

items.text: Would you like tea, coffee, or something cold?
items.tip: 列举时前两项微升，最后一项降下来，形成收束。
items.zh: 你想要茶、咖啡，还是冷饮？

items.text: You've finished the report already, haven't you?
items.tip: 反义疑问句在这里用降调，表示确认而不是真的发问。
items.zh: 你已经写完报告了，对吧？

items.text: I didn't take your umbrella — I took mine.
items.tip: 前半句平调铺垫，破折号后 mine 重读并降调，突出对比。
items.zh: 我没拿你的伞——我拿的是我自己的。

items.text: Could you possibly open the window?
items.tip: 礼貌请求用缓升调，possibly 稍加重，句尾轻轻上扬。
items.zh: 你能把窗户打开一下吗？

items.text: Why on earth would you do that?
items.tip: 整句偏高，do 重读后急降，表达惊讶和不理解。
items.zh: 你到底为什么要那么做？

items.text: It's not a bad idea, actually.
items.tip: 用降升调：idea 先降后微升，暗示态度有所保留。
items.zh: 其实这主意还不错。

items.text: Do you want to eat now or wait until later?
items.tip: 选择疑问句：now 升、later 降，两个选项形成对比。
items.zh: 你想现在吃，还是等到晚一点？

items.text: That was a lovely evening, wasn't it?
items.tip: 句尾用升调寻求对方认同，语气比降调更亲切。
items.zh: 那真是个愉快的夜晚，不是吗？

drills.title: Break long sentences into thought groups

items.text: When you get to the station, give me a call and I'll come and meet you.
items.tip: 分成三块：When you get to the station / give me a call / and I'll come and meet you。
items.zh: 你到车站后给我打个电话，我来接你。

items.text: If you finish the report before Friday, we can send it to the client early.
items.tip: 在逗号处换气，条件句一块，主句一块，不要逐词停顿。
items.zh: 如果你周五前写完报告，我们可以提前发给客户。

items.text: The thing is, I've already booked the tickets, so we can't change the date now.
items.tip: The thing is 单独一块作铺垫，so 前再停顿一次。
items.zh: 问题是，我已经订好票了，所以现在没法改日期。

items.text: What I'd suggest is that we split the work and meet again on Thursday.
items.tip: What I'd suggest is 后稍停，that 从句整体读出，重音落在 split 和 Thursday。
items.zh: 我的建议是我们把工作分开，周四再碰面。

items.text: Although it was raining, we decided to walk to the restaurant anyway.
items.tip: 让步状语一块，主句一块，逗号处是最自然的换气点。
items.zh: 尽管在下雨，我们还是决定步行去餐厅。

drills.title: Keep the flow, lose the rush

items.text: To be honest, I wasn't expecting the interview to be that difficult.
items.tip: To be honest 快速带过，主句放慢，difficult 重读并稍作延长。
items.zh: 说实话，我没想到面试会那么难。

items.text: The problem with the plan is that nobody has enough time to test it.
items.tip: 在 plan 后停顿，is that 连读，后半句整块推出。
items.zh: 这个计划的问题在于，没有人有足够的时间去测试它。

items.text: As far as I can tell, the shop closes at six on weekdays.
items.tip: As far as I can tell 一块读完，主句在 closes 上加重。
items.zh: 据我所知，这家店工作日下午六点关门。

items.text: What we need to do first is find out who has the key.
items.tip: first 后停顿，find out 连读，who has the key 一气呵成。
items.zh: 我们首先需要弄清楚谁有钥匙。

items.text: If I were you, I'd wait until the prices come down a bit.
items.tip: 条件句和主句分开，come down a bit 连成一块，句尾自然降调。
items.zh: 如果我是你，我会等到价格降一点再买。
